name: Tallying Fist
description: Count each landed punch and let the next one carry its sum onto the same spot.

name: Climbing Stride
description: Add a little more length to each stride so the body gains pace as it advances.

name: Layered Guard
description: Lay one thin guard over another until the stack holds against a blow that one alone could not.

name: Heaped Jab
description: Heap jab on jab into one point until the guard there gives way.

name: Snowfall Barrage
description: Rain blows that come one at a time at first and then in drifts too thick to follow.

name: Piled Pressure
description: Stack a layer of qi pressure on the target each breath until they can no longer lift an arm.

name: Weighted Echo
description: Land a blow and let its echo come back heavier from the target's own body.

name: Avalanche Fist
description: Start with a light blow and let the force pile onto itself as it falls through the target.

name: Brimming Cascade
description: Pour a cascade of force that fills to the brim and spills over all who stand around the user.

name: Infinite Weight
description: Let a single touch grow in weight without a limit until the target is pressed to the ground.

name: Paired Reach
description: Thrust both palms forward on matched lines of qi that keep lengthening toward the target.

name: Mirrored Lance
description: Stab with two lances of qi that mirror each other and close upon one point.

name: Double Thread
description: Cast two thin lines of qi from the fingers that run on without a break.

name: Reach Guard
description: Hold both arms out and let the ward on each lengthen to meet the other.

name: Length Sense
description: Feel along both lines of qi to know how far each has reached and what it touches.

name: Doubled Lance
description: Drive two lances that keep growing and cross inside the target to tear its guard.

name: Matched Cord
description: Pay out two cords of qi in a matched pair that lengthen with every pull and tie the target.

name: Extended Parry
description: Extend the arm in a parry whose reach grows to catch a blow and answer it in one motion.

name: Limitless Lance
description: Thrust one lance that lengthens past every guard and every pace the target puts between them.

name: Horizonless Reach
description: Send a line of qi toward the far edge of sight that does not stop until it finds a body.

name: Everlance
description: Cast a lance of qi that lengthens after it strikes so the wound deepens without a stop.

name: Unfailing Spring
description: Open a hand over a wound and let a spring of qi that never runs low close it for an ally or the self.

name: Brimming Hand
description: Rest a brimming hand on a hurt and let the qi spill over into it until it eases.

name: Steady Overflow
description: Share the spill of the user's reserve with a tired ally so their strength returns at an even rate.

name: Overflow Ward
description: Let the overflow of the reserve pour over a patient as a ward that holds as long as it runs.

name: Constant Tide
description: Send a tide of restoring qi in and out of a wound that never ebbs until the mending is done.

name: Cleansing Spring
description: Wash an ally or the self in an unceasing spring of clean qi that flushes out poison and taint.

name: Wellspring Revival
description: Open a wellspring of qi into a heart that has only just stopped and drive the pulse to restart.

name: Unfailing Torrent
description: Pour an unfailing torrent of qi into a gravely hurt ally to close their wounds and return strength.

name: Aeon Font
description: Open a font of restoring qi over the wounded that mends them all and feeds on its own flow.

name: Unceasing Run
description: Break into a wind-borne run that loses nothing between one stride and the next.

name: Pace Unflagging
description: Hold the same fast pace over a long chase with breath and qi both renewing.

name: Gust Cross
description: Cross the line of the opponent at a run and strike as the gust passes.

name: Breath Cycle
description: Cycle the breath with the stride so the lungs and the legs feed each other.

name: Far Draught
description: Throw a draught of qi on the run that carries as far as the runner's gaze.

name: Sprint Surge
description: Burst from a run into a hard strike without losing any of the speed.

name: Gale Pursuit
description: Chase a fleeing target at gale pace and tie a loop of wind to its ankle as it tires.

name: Unflagging Gale
description: Share the unflagging wind of the run with an ally so their legs never tire.

name: Wind Chain
description: Chain the target to the run with a lengthening ring of wind that drags at its limbs.

name: Endless Run
description: Run without pause in a great loop and strike at each pass with growing speed.

name: Gale Cascade
description: Send a cascade of gale that rolls on and on across the ground and sweeps all before it.

name: Flash Unending
description: Flash from point to point along the run with no break between and strike at the end of each.

name: Vow Renewed Guard
description: Renew a vow of standing with each blow taken so the guard stiffens rather than frays.

name: Sworn Increment
description: Add a small sworn increment of strength to the user or an ally with each kept vow.

name: Oath Lance
description: Thrust a lance of qi on a sworn line that does not shorten with distance.

name: Keeping Step
description: Take steps that keep the heading of the oath without deviation however the foe moves.

name: Compounding Oath
description: Let each kept vow in a fight add to the force of the next strike thrown.

name: Growing Cord
description: Tie a cord of qi to the foe under oath that grows in length and strength as long as it is held.

name: Bearing Throw
description: Throw a bolt of qi along the bearing of a sworn mark and keep it flying to the end.

name: Limitless Oath
description: Swear an oath that knows no limit and seal the target's qi in it for as long as the oath stands.

name: Heading Kept
description: Strike along a heading kept true through every dodge so the blow cannot be shaken from its mark.

name: Perpetual Vow
description: Swear a vow that renews itself each breath and binds the foe while lending the user its strength.

name: Reserve Tap
description: Tap the deep reserve in the lower belly and draw a fresh measure of qi at once.

name: Open Reservoir
description: Open the reservoir to a near ally and let a shared stream run from it.

name: Bottomless Guard
description: Hold a guard fed from a reserve so deep that no blow reaches the bottom of it.

name: Gale Aegis
description: Spin a thin aegis of wind around the body that holds without a wall.

name: Stored Breath
description: Breathe out a stored breath of qi into a wound and close it for an ally or the self.

name: Deep Reserve
description: Draw on a deep reserve to strengthen a guard and the limbs of the user together.

name: Refilling Gale
description: Send a refilling gale of qi through a wound that mends a little more with each pass.

name: Reservoir Rebound
description: Take a blow into the reservoir and send it back along the same line at once.

name: Bottomless Reserve
description: Open a reserve with no floor and feed an ally strength and mending at the same time.

name: Tide Unwalled
description: Meet a charge with an open tide of qi that has no wall to break and turns the rush aside.

name: Infinite Reservoir
description: Drink a blow into a reservoir with no end and turn the force into mending for the user.
